title: MTX_Holiday_Cheer

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who would you want to spend the holidays with?
Have you ever tried to ruin a holiday on purpose?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Christmas Tree,

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, Christmas Tree...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hum hum hum hum hum huuuuum hum!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I love that song... Yawn.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Zzz...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice work, everyone!
A wave of exhaustion washes over $ZOE...
...And she wakes up as the sun rises over the courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The... The presents! They're all gone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who would do such a thing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The kids are going to be devastated.
$ZOE goes over to the twins' sleeping bags and tries to wake them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a second...
Two mannequins fill the spots where the twins had been before!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why those little...

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Merry Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But... Where are the presents?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There... Uh... Aren't any?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: But I... I don't understand?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I was so good all year.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Does Santa think we were bad?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I... I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! No! Don't cry!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great work, $ZOE. You managed to ruin Thriftmas for everyone. I probably couldn't have pulled that off if I `tried.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Great work, $ZOE. You managed to ruin Thriftmas for everyone. I probably couldn't have pulled that off if I [color=#3b78e2][i]tried.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Meanwhile, out in the mall parking lot, the twins are sitting in a pile of opened boxes and wrapping paper.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `More` socks?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]More[/i][/color] socks?!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: These are the worst presents ever!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What could we possibly have done to deserve this?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well... We did steal all of these presents.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh yeah...
Ouch... You did so badly, we're stopping you early.
This is no way for things to end!
If only you'd done a better job with the kids, maybe it wouldn't have come to this...
You might want to start over and try again.

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Frosty the... Reindeer, had a very shiny... `Hat?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Frosty the... Reindeer, had a very shiny... [color=#3b78e2][i]Hat?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And a corn cob `shoe`, and a pirate `crew`, and a hamster, and a `cat!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And a corn cob [color=#3b78e2][i]shoe[/i][/color], and a pirate [color=#3b78e2][i]crew[/i][/color], and a hamster, and a [color=#3b78e2][i]cat![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Those aren't the lyrics at all!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Riot! Riot!
The kids start running around and tearing up decorations until...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Freeze, dirtbags! Don't you `dare` attack my mall!
nodes.text_bbcode: Freeze, dirtbags! Don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]dare[/i][/color] attack my mall!

nodes.text: Officer Monte brandishes his billy club at the kids.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's the fuzz!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry about this, officer... The kids got upset after we messed up the lyrics to some Christmas carols.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Singing the wrong lyrics to a Christmas carol on Christmas Eve?! I should lock you up just on principle.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Lucky for you, I'm trying to be `extra` good tonight... I'm really hoping Santa will bring me a new flak jacket.
nodes.text_bbcode: Lucky for you, I'm trying to be [color=#e23b3b][i]extra[/i][/color] good tonight... I'm really hoping Santa will bring me a new flak jacket.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And last year, I got even less coal than usual in my stocking...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But mess up like this again, and I `promise` I'll come down on you with a fury that would make the Grinch look like the Sugar Plum Fairy!
nodes.text_bbcode: But mess up like this again, and I [color=#e23b3b][i]promise[/i][/color] I'll come down on you with a fury that would make the Grinch look like the Sugar Plum Fairy!

nodes.text: Officer Monte leaves, and a few minutes later, the kids are all finally ready to go to sleep.
A little later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, kids... It's starting to get late.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'd better get you all to bed so that it's safe for Santa to come make his deliveries!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But we're not tired yet.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Actually, I'm am getting kind of slee...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I `said` we're not tired!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]said[/i][/color] we're not tired!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Sometimes, when I have trouble going to sleep, Colt will sing me a lullaby...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He does?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's a great idea, Maddie! Maybe we could sing a couple of Christmas carols to help you all fall asleep.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not singing.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can hum!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll try to help... But I can't exactly remember all of the lyrics.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh... Sam has a good point! I'd better try to remember the words to some songs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... It `is` bending the rules a little. But sometimes children who are `very` good are allowed to open `one` present on Christmas Eve.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] bending the rules a little. But sometimes children who are [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] good are allowed to open [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] present on Christmas Eve.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We've been `so` good this year!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] good this year!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The best!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... You can go ahead and open a gift. But remember, you have to `keep` being good all night if you want Santa to bring you more presents tomorrow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay... You can go ahead and open a gift. But remember, you have to [color=#3b78e2][i]keep[/i][/color] being good all night if you want Santa to bring you more presents tomorrow.

nodes.text: As the kids sit down to open one gift each, they lean in and start whispering to each other.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So... Hard... So much potential mischief to be made at the mall.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Everyone stay good! We can't risk getting Santa mad at us! That means you, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But... But I really `have` been good all year!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... But I really [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been good all year!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. I almost forgot that even little pranksters like Kay and Kel have to act good on Christmas Eve. It really is the most magical night of the year!
The kids open their gifts.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: 'Sally's Dream Mansion'?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: 'G. I. Shmoe, with real, working grappling hook'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you two should trade...

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: 'Sally's Dream Mansion'!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: 'G. I. Shmoe, with real, working grappling hook'!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And I got a 10,000-piece puzzle!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's put them both together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Perfect! That should keep them busy for a while!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who wants peanut brittle?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Me!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Me! Me! Me!
$ZOE opens up a box of peanut brittle and passes it around the group.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So... Much... Sugar!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Major corn syrup rush...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's climb stuff!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I bet I can get to the top of that tree over there before you can!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Doesn't that seem a little dangerous?
The kids all run off and start climbing trees.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just so you know, if one of them falls and breaks a leg, I'm telling `everyone` that you gave them peanut brittle and made them crazy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just so you know, if one of them falls and breaks a leg, I'm telling [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] that you gave them peanut brittle and made them crazy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kids! Come down from that branch!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: How do I get down from here?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I think the sugar... Is wearing off!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm scared.
$ZOE and Sam spend the next two hours finding a ladder. By the time the kids are safely on the ground, most of them are crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've definitely had better Christmas Eves...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor? Why is there a big sign above us that says 'Merry Thriftmas! Welcome to Hu-Ville?'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: George `Hu` is the energy tycoon who bought the mall this year.
nodes.text_bbcode: George [color=#3b78e2][i]Hu[/i][/color] is the energy tycoon who bought the mall this year.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So he named this section of the mall 'Hu-ville'!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And since he made his money selling electricity, he made sure that this place is well lit! Hence the orange glow all around us.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: He paid for everything...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The decorations... The presents for the kids... The treats.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Presents?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Presents?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: `Treats?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Treats?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Presents!` Now!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Presents![/i][/color] Now!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No! Give us the `treats` first!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Give us the [color=#3b78e2][i]treats[/i][/color] first!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great... If I know the twins, they're not going to calm down until they get either presents or treats...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But we're not supposed to unwrap the gifts until tomorrow morning... And I'm `really` not sure I should give them sugar.
nodes.text_bbcode: But we're not supposed to unwrap the gifts until tomorrow morning... And I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] not sure I should give them sugar.

nodes.prompt: They get either presents of treats...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: They get either presents of treats...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay! Story time!
The kids all sit down and look up at Zoe expectantly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Oops. This would work a lot better if I'd actually `brought` a book to read.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Oops. This would work a lot better if I'd actually [color=#3b78e2][i]brought[/i][/color] a book to read.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't worry, $ZOE... I brought something.
Taylor hands $ZOE a book...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'The Pool Boy's Confession'?! This is a trashy romance novel!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That book looks awesome! I bet the pool boy plays `lots` of pranks!
nodes.text_bbcode: That book looks awesome! I bet the pool boy plays [color=#3b78e2][i]lots[/i][/color] of pranks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think I should read this to you. How about I just make up a story?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No way! Pool Boy! Pool Boy!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Pool Boy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Fine.
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: '...as usual, his abs shone under the hot afternoon sun. They glistened with water. Pool water.'

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Yawn.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Bo-ring. All he ever does is take off his shirt and clean the pool!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He's kind of like that guy in 'Dusklight'... Except he never turns into a werewolf.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you `trying` to ruin these kids' Thriftmas, $ZOE?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to ruin these kids' Thriftmas, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're the one who gave me this stupid book!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now you're just making excuses... How sad.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Mall tour!
Amanda sprints off toward the far end of the mall, and the kids run after her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess we should... Follow them?
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...and if you combine the fifty-percent off online coupon with the instant cash back deal from the newspaper, they'll pay `you` to get candy here!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...and if you combine the fifty-percent off online coupon with the instant cash back deal from the newspaper, they'll pay [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] to get candy here!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Best. Tour. Ever!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Amanda is the smartest high schooler of all time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The kids seem really happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not to mention tired from running all over the mall. That should pay off when it's time to put them to bed!
As the tour concludes, the children clap, and Amanda takes a deep bow.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's so great about free candy, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Enough!` We've got a lot to do before the children show up.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Enough![/i][/color] We've got a lot to do before the children show up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The kids will be here in half an hour, and by the time they arrive, I want this place looking like a winter frickin' wonderland.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The box of decorations is right over there. Get to it. I'll be busy changing into my Santa costume.
Taylor struts off to the ladies' room.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow. She's as twisted as a candy cane and a lot less sweet. I say we get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! I know Taylor can be... Difficult. But think about the kids! Don't we want to make this a special, uh, 'Thriftmas' for them?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides... It's not like my parents are going to be here for Christmas Eve anyway...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw, $ZOE... It's okay. They're gonna be here tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And sure, I want to be home with my family on Christmas Eve... But `you're` my family now.
nodes.text_bbcode: And sure, I want to be home with my family on Christmas Eve... But [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] my family now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, technically we've always been family. We're cousins.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The point is, we're together. And we're going to help some kids have a merry Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So we stay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We stay.
Sam starts looking through the box of decorations.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, I want to do some decorating for my own sake. It's like 70 degrees out... Some fake snow on the ground might put me back in the holiday spirit.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mmm... Fake snow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amanda! Don't eat that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, girls... Let's get these decorations up!
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's time to reach our arms around our shoulders to give ourselves a collective pat on the back!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nice work everyone!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It looks just like the North Pole!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh. Christmas is so tacky.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Apparently, Frosty the Snowman never heard that you `don't` wear white after labor day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Apparently, Frosty the Snowman never heard that you [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] wear white after labor day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, you know a 'good job' wouldn't hurt.
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That looks... Good?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we have a tree and presents...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it kind of looks like 'The Frightmare Before Christmas' in here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... I thought that's what we were going for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that a zombie reindeer over there?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm scared...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What `happened` in here? Are you trying to make me look bad on purpose?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]happened[/i][/color] in here? Are you trying to make me look bad on purpose?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not that you could ever really make me `look` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that you could ever really make me [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll remember this the next time I'm picking who goes where in the cheerleading pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe if `you` hadn't spent thirty minutes changing into a `hat`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] hadn't spent thirty minutes changing into a [color=#3b78e2][i]hat[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? `Elves` are supposed to be quiet and follow orders.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what? [color=#3b78e2][i]Elves[/i][/color] are supposed to be quiet and follow orders.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But we're not...
Taylor throws elf hats to Sam and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is degrading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, I dunno. I think it's kind of cute.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why don't I get one?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because you already look like an elf without the hat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That wasn't meant as a compliment! I mean... Here. Take this hat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Double yay!
A few minutes later, the kids start to arrive.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa! Awesome powder! I wish I'd brought my snowboard!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Scary... Why does that snowman have a jack-o-lantern for a head?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... Ignore that.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Thanks for bringing me here, Colt! You're the best big brother ever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt?! You brought Maddie here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I figured I might stick around for a while too... Just, uh, for her sake, you know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hehe.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Over there, Howard! I see Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Nice! Chip `loves` doing whatever we tell him to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice! Chip [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] doing whatever we tell him to do!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This is going to be the best Christmas ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, Howard... You brought your little sisters?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When they heard you were spending Christmas Eve at the mall, they insisted that I bring them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And believe me, they can be `very` persuasive.
nodes.text_bbcode: And believe me, they can be [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] persuasive.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't realize everyone was inviting their `boyfriends` to stay over.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't realize everyone was inviting their [color=#3b78e2][i]boyfriends[/i][/color] to stay over.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Santa is acting scary!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If Colt and Howard aren't gone by the time I count to three, it's going to be a very, very sad Christmas for a certain pair of elves.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: One... Two...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just remembered, I have to go clean... The chimney! In case Santa stops by. See you later!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You really think you can make me leave, blondie? I'd `love` to see you try.
nodes.text_bbcode: You really think you can make me leave, blondie? I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] to see you try.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Sniff... Colt... You can't fight on Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, shoot, Maddie. Don't get all teary now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What I `meant` was that I'd better go clean... My motorcycle. In case Santa's sleigh breaks down and he needs a ride!
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#e23b3b][i]meant[/i][/color] was that I'd better go clean... My motorcycle. In case Santa's sleigh breaks down and he needs a ride!

nodes.text: The boys head out the nearest exit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great... Just when the night was starting to look like fun...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's Taylor's problem anyway?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Sniff... Colt...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Don't worry about that, kids! I think it's time for our first activity.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I brought some games! Anyone want to play checkers?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Checkers? `Checkers?` Did somebody just mention `checkers?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Checkers? [color=#3b78e2][i]Checkers?[/i][/color] Did somebody just mention [color=#3b78e2][i]checkers?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong with checkers?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's personal.
Taylor snatches away Sam's checkers set and tosses it into the mall's fountain.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Eek!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Calm down, everyone. It's okay. We'll just do another activity!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How about...

options.label: We take a tour of the mall!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Due to a lack of promotion, it looks like only four kids are coming.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, that's no problem! With so few kids to look after, taking care of them should be easy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can shower each kid with love and affection... Just like it should be on Christmas Eve!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you `have` to see the silver lining around every dark cloud?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to see the silver lining around every dark cloud?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who do you think you are? A silver-lining shop owning, silver-selling, silver-loving silversmith?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just thought that this could be fun...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! Especially once the rest of the team shows up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. So here's the thing about that. The other cheerleaders aren't coming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You said attendance was required!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's just... Apparently there's some silly local law about not forcing people to work on Thriftmas Eve...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So the other cheerleaders decided to cancel and spend tonight with their stupid families.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But now that you're here, you're staying!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What a load of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one else is coming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You said attendance was required!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's just... Apparently there's some silly local law about not forcing people to work on Thriftmas Eve...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So the other cheerleaders decided to cancel and spend tonight with their stupid families.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I can't handle this!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Pretty soon, there's going to be a hundred little kids running around here, tearing this mall apart!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not good with kids, $ZOE! `I'm not good with kids!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not good with kids, $ZOE! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm not good with kids![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Easy, there... No one panic!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Panic! It's time to panic!
Amanda turns and runs straight into a wall.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Calm down, you pathetic, marshmallow-brained excuses for cheerleaders!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The other news is that only four kids are coming.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, `oh!` Taking care of just four kids should be a piece of cake!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]oh![/i][/color] Taking care of just four kids should be a piece of cake!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Why didn't you say so in the first place?
Taylor shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, this is no way to start off the night...
Taylor and Amanda start stuffing the decorations into some boxes...
Then Taylor slithers and sneaks, with a grin most unpleasant,
Around the whole room, and she takes every present!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Mwa ha ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Actually, we `are` pretty naughty.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] pretty naughty.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah. Like we replaced Howard's deodorant with bacon grease so he'd smell like breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we cut the butts out of all his jeans to make a patchwork parachute so that we can become paratroopers.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we started an experiment where we renamed out neighbor's dog 'cat' just to see what would happen.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And we've been leaving fake teeth under our pillows to try to fool the tooth fairy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I get it. You've been `very` naughty.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, okay... I get it. You've been [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] naughty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's not why all the Christmas decorations are gone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think it's time we found out just who `really` took all of the presents!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think it's time we found out just who [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] took all of the presents!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Christmas isn't about presents.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Christmas is about loving each other!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's about sharing time with your family... Or building a family out of friends!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We may not have any presents this morning, but we've got each other... And it's still Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Sniff... I guess we did have fun together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe we could, you know, sing a Christmas song again!
$ZOE sings the first few words of 'Oh, Christmas Tree', and soon, everyone has joined in...
Or at least, `almost` everyone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or at least, [b]almost[/b] everyone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everyone here in Hu-ville, the tall and the small...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is singing! Without any presents at all!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `haven't` stopped Christmas from coming!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]haven't[/i][/color] stopped Christmas from coming!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It came!
As the song ends, $ZOE turns and looks at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad everyone's spirits are lifted...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But now I think it's time we found out just who `really` took all of the presents!
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I think it's time we found out just who [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] took all of the presents!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What kind of person would write something like that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! I know those words from some of the rap song Hector listens to!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is just one more sign that everyone in the world sucks and that Christmas deserves to be ruined.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks for proving me right!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, Amanda just put everything in the trunk of my ca...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My car!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's just put everything in the car... Who cares who that is?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh right. You're still on Quiet Time. `Keep it up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh right. You're still on Quiet Time. [color=#3b78e2][i]Keep it up.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The figures disappear into the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wonder who that was...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot. I hope they didn't identify us or anything....

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great. Now this is going to bother me for the rest of the night.
Taylor drops her sack and runs to catch up with the figures...
...And finds the twins!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're caught!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you two doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We deny everything! We're innocent! We're not saying anything without a lawyer present!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As far as I'm concerned, you two are guilty until proven innocent. Tell me what you're doing, or I'm telling Santa just how naughty you really are!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No! Please! Don't put us on the 'naughty' list! We'll talk! We'll talk!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We were trying to sneak back home so we could lay a trap for Santa!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We left inflatable snowmen in our sleeping bags and snuck out a while ago!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: The bus we've been waiting for should be here any minute!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And we promise to be back before morning... No one will ever know!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please don't tell!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have half a mind to trap you in the mall's pet store and let out all of the snakes.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Wait a second... What are `you` doing out here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second... What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We're planning a surprise!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda! `Quiet Time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda! [color=#3b78e2][i]Quiet Time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now listen here and listen good, you little monsters.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You go on home and trap whatever holiday creatures you want. Snowmen, reindeer, Santas... Whatever. I recommend a bear trap if you've got one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And if you mention `one word` about bumping into us, I'll make sure you end up on the `Permanent Naughty List!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you mention [color=#3b78e2][i]one word[/i][/color] about bumping into us, I'll make sure you end up on the [color=#3b78e2][i]Permanent Naughty List![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Not the `Permanent Naughty List!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not the [color=#3b78e2][i]Permanent Naughty List![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That's supposed to be reserved for dictators and mafia hitmen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And very, very bad little girls.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It... It's a deal! As far as we're concerned, we never saw you out here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent. It was nice `not` bumping into you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Excellent. It was nice [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] bumping into you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Bullying people smaller than me is `always` fun... But doing it on Christmas Eve is just that much sweeter!
nodes.text_bbcode: Bullying people smaller than me is [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] fun... But doing it on Christmas Eve is just that much sweeter!

nodes.text: Taylor accidentally steps on a Christmas ornament. The sharp edge goes right through her Prazza heel!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stupid Christmas! It's trying to kill me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ow ow ow ow ow!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are your feet okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Who cares about my feet? Those shoes cost more than most of these brats' parents will make in a year!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You may have won this round, Christmas... But I'll get the last laugh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And at least no one woke up...
Taylor and Amanda finish packing up the rest of the decorations.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Amanda... Since you're up, would you mind helping me with something?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Helping... Helping! Doing some last minute good might help add some points in Santa's 'nice' column!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fabulous. So here's what we're going to do...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're going to steal... I mean `move` all of the decorations. And take them to my place!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to steal... I mean [color=#3b78e2][i]move[/i][/color] all of the decorations. And take them to my place!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We are?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's right! That way, in the morning, we can take all of these kids over there and show them a real-life mansion!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Except those kids won't be `invited` to my place. They'll just wake up to find Christmas `all gone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Except those kids won't be [color=#3b78e2][i]invited[/i][/color] to my place. They'll just wake up to find Christmas [color=#3b78e2][i]all gone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Amanda. It'll be the best Christmas these poor brats... Er, I mean, 'darling children' ever had!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hooray!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay. The key is going to be making sure we don't wake anyone up as we take away the presents and decorations.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: After all, we wouldn't want to ruin the 'surprise'.

nodes.text_bbcode: You know, Amanda... You might have a better chance of seeing Santa if he [color=#3b78e2][i]actually existed![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're hilarious, Taylor! If Santa doesn't exist, then who lives at the North Pole?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What the...?! There `is` no North Pole!
nodes.text_bbcode: What the...?! There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no North Pole!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I've seen it on a map...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... Not... I mean... There `is` a North Pole, just not a...
nodes.text_bbcode: No... Not... I mean... There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a North Pole, just not a...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hmm... Now you're just contradicting yourself.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can't believe I just lost an argument to Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I can't let this little setback get in the way of my master plan...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... Why are you being so quiet?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it because you think Santa isn't bringing me anything this year?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do... Do you think he knows I secretly made out with Hector a whole bunch of times while I was still dating Zach?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do you think he knows I secretly pretend gummy bears are alive and then eat them feet-first?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Santa knows `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Santa knows [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm not even going to get `coal` in my stocking...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not even going to get [color=#3b78e2][i]coal[/i][/color] in my stocking...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll probably just get reindeer poo.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hehe. My plan to ruin Christmas is starting off perfectly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... It's my first Christmas away from home.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But having you come find me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I just feel `home` when you're around.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I just feel [color=#3b78e2][i]home[/i][/color] when you're around.

nodes.text: Howard and $ZOE spend the next half hour kissing, holding hands, and talking...
And a little later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... I think it's about time for us to head back and get some sleep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I know the twins at all, I'm guessing we're in for an early Christmas morning.
Out in the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, Howard... It's really sweet that you went through so much trouble to come get me...
Howard creeps up to the sleeping bag and finds...
An inflatable snowman!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait a second... This must be one of the Twins' sleeping bags!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which means that there might be... Booby traps!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just might have to strangle my little sisters... And on Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! You came for me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... But there's no time to talk now. Let's get out of here!

And finds Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Zzz... Mmm... Colt...
Sam leans up and sleepily kisses Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mmph!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?! Get off of my girl!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Wait! This is all a big mistake!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm gonna punch you in the gut so hard, you're gonna need to ask Santa for a new spleen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No seriously. You've got me all wrong! I mean, it wasn't even that good of a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now you're saying my girl is a bad kisser?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! I mean... I'm just saying... We need to get out of here before Taylor wakes up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... But I'll be watching you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Get near Sam again, and I'll punch your skull out of your head.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Um... I figured. Just come with me, quick!

And finds $ZOE!

nodes.text: Howard! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you really think Taylor was going to get rid of me that easily?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hehe. I guess I should have known you wouldn't give up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Babe, babe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What... What's going on? Did you break out of juvie to come make out with me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... No. I've been out for months. Remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh! Sorry! Just... A recurring dream... I mean, nothing. Er... Never mind.

nodes.text: Great. How are we supposed to know which ones are the girls?

nodes.text: Hm... Wait a second... A couple of days ago, $ZOE was telling me about her sleeping bag.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure it's...

nodes.text: Freeze, scum. I'm gonna send you to a cell so deep underground even Santa won't be able to find you.

nodes.text: Five-O! Five-O! Run for it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gotta find a hiding spot! Oh... That dumpster over there will work!
Howard raises the lid and leaps into the dumpster... Where he splashes down into...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Eggnog? It's got to be two feet deep! One of the restaurants in the mall must have thrown out their leftovers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess this is what I get for jumping into a dumpster on Christmas Eve.

nodes.text: You smell worse than the bathroom at juvie. And believe me, that's saying something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Can we just go get the girls now?

nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.text: It smells like `intruders` out here.

nodes.text: So, what now? Want to go egg Taylor's house? Toilet paper her front yard? Shave her dog?

nodes.text: Is this how you `usually` spend Christmas Eve?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nah. Usually I spend it throwing rocks at bottles down by the lake.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking we could spend `this one` with our girlfriends... If we can sneak them out of that mall.

nodes.text: I've had a crazy year... And I had my heart broken way too many times.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But now that I'm with $ZOE, I know it was all worth it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But who cares if I'm with her if I can't actually be `with` her on Christmas Eve?!

nodes.text: You know... I spent a lot of lonely nights in juvie imagining what life would be like when I got out.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Part of that was freedom... The freedom to spend my time with the people I care about.

nodes.speaker: Colt
